content: enumeration PerErrc [SWS_PER_00311] Upstream: RS_AP_00122 , RS_AP_00125 , RS_AP_00127 , RS_AP_00149 enum class PerErrc : ara::core::ErrorDomain::CodeType {...}; Defines the errors for Persistency. The enumeration values 0 - 255 are reserved for AUTOSAR assigned errors, the stack provider is free to define additional errors starting from 256. Header-Datei #include "ara/per/per_error_domain.h" class mono Forwarding-Header #include "ara/per/per_fwd.h" class mono Scope namespace ara::per class mono Symbol PerErrc class mono Basistyp ara::core::ErrorDomain::CodeType class mono Werte th Enumerator th Beschreibung td kStorageNotFound td =1 The requested Key-Value Storage or File Storage is not configured in the AUTOSAR model. td kKeyNotFound td =2 The provided key cannot be not found in the Key-Value Storage. td kIllegalWriteAccess td =3 The operation could not be performed because the accessed Key-Value Storage or File Storage is configured as read-only or write-only-once. td kPhysicalStorageFailure td =4 An error occurred when accessing the physical storage, e.g. because of a corrupted file system or corrupted hardware, or because of insufficient access rights. td kIntegrityCorrupted td =5 The structural integrity of the Key-Value Storage or File Storage could not be established. This can happen when the internal structure of a Key-Value Storage or the metadata of a File Storage is corrupted. td kValidationFailed td =6 The validation of redundancy measures failed for a single key-value pair, for the whole Key-Value Storage, for a single file, or for the whole File Storage. td kEncryptionFailed td =7 The encryption or decryption failed for a single key-value pair, for the whole Key-Value Storage, for a single file, or for the whole File Storage. td kDataTypeMismatch td =8 The provided data type does not match the stored data type. td kInitValueNotAvailable td =9 The operation could not be performed because no initial value is available. td kResourceBusy td = 10 The operation could not be performed because the resource is currently busy. td kOutOfStorageSpace td = 12 The physical storage space was exceeded. td kFileNotFound td = 13 The requested file name cannot be not found in the File Storage. td kInvalidPosition td = 15 SetPosition tried to move to a position that is not reachable (i.e. which is smaller than zero or greater than the current size of the file). td kEof td = 16 The Persistency user tried to read from the end of the file or from an empty file. td kInvalidOpenMode td = 17 Opening a file failed because the requested combination of Open Modes is invalid. td kInvalidSize td = 18 SetFileSize tried to set a new size that is bigger than the current file size. td kTooManyFiles td = 19 The maximum number of files was exceeded. td kQuotaExceeded td = 20 The allocated storage quota was exceeded. td kAuthenticationFailed td = 21 Calculating or checking of the MAC failed for a single key-value pair, for the whole Key-Value Storage, for a single file, or for the whole File Storage.
